legend: In the Wonderful Metropolis of the Future, there is no need in subway train drivers. Due to the technological progress, they were replaced by the Artificial Intelligence (AI). Unfortunately, one day the predictions of sci-fi writers came true: the AI rebelled and now there is an uncontrollable train in the subway. It can be dangerous! Your task is to find the train and stop the AI.

The subway of the Metropolis is one line (regular straight line with no self-intersections) with n$$$n$$$ stations, indexed consecutively from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$. At each moment the train is at some station. You need to determine the index of this station, so that the train would be secured.

To find the train, dispatcher Sarah gave you a gadget that allows you to select arbitrary numbers l$$$l$$$ and r$$$r$$$ (l≤r$$$l \le r$$$), and then check, whether the train is located on a station with index between l$$$l$$$ and r$$$r$$$, inclusive. Unfortunately, recharging of the gadget takes some time (and every time you use it as soon as possible), so between two applications of the gadget the train can move to any station that is at most k$$$k$$$ stations away. Formally, if the train was at the station x$$$x$$$ when the gadget was applied, then at the next application of the gadget the train can appear at any station y$$$y$$$ such that max(1,x−k)≤y≤min(n,x+k)$$$\max(1, x - k) \leq y \leq \min(n, x + k)$$$.
Note that AI is not aware that you are trying to catch the train, so it makes all moves according to its predefined plan.
After an examination of the gadget you found that it is very old and can hold no more than 4500$$$4500$$$ applications, after which it will break and your mission will be considered a failure.
Can you find the station with the train using no more than 4500$$$4500$$$ applications of the gadgets?
input: The first line contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (1≤n≤1018$$$1 \leq n \leq 10^{18}$$$, 0≤k≤10$$$0 \leq k \leq 10$$$) — the number of stations and the maximum number of stations the train can move between two applications of the gadget.

You can apply the gadget at most 4500$$$4500$$$ times. In order to apply the gadget you need to print two space-separated integers l$$$l$$$ and r$$$r$$$ (1≤l≤r≤n$$$1 \leq l \leq r \leq n$$$). You will then receive either string "Yes", if the train is between stations l$$$l$$$ and r$$$r$$$, inclusive, or string "No" otherwise. If l=r$$$l = r$$$ and you received "Yes", then you found the train successfully, and your program must halt immediately.

Answer "Bad" instead of "Yes" or "No" means that you made an invalid query or made too many queries. Exit immediately after receiving "Bad" and you will see Wrong answer verdict. Otherwise you can get an arbitrary verdict because your solution will continue to read from a closed stream.

In order to hack, you should present a test in the following format.

The first line should contain three integers n$$$n$$$, k$$$k$$$ and p$$$p$$$ (1≤n≤1018$$$1 \le n \le 10^{18}$$$, 0≤k≤10$$$0 \le k \le 10$$$, 1≤p≤n$$$1 \le p \le n$$$) — the number of stations, the maximum number of stations the train can move between two applications of the gadget and the initial position of the train, respectively.

Each of the next 4500$$$4500$$$ lines should contain a single integer x$$$x$$$ (1≤x≤n$$$1 \le x \le n$$$) — the positions of the train after each query. Two consecutive positions (including the initial one) should not differ by more than k$$$k$$$.

legend.ai: 在未来的奇妙都市中，地铁列车不再需要驾驶员。由于技术进步，他们被人工智能（AI）取代了。不幸的是，有一天科幻作家们的预言成真了：AI 发生了叛乱，现在地铁中有一辆失控的列车。这可能非常危险！你的任务是找到这辆列车并阻止 AI。
这座都市的地铁是一条线路(没有自交点的普通直线)，上面有 n$$$n$$$ 个车站，编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 依次排列。在任意时刻，列车都位于某个车站。你需要确定该车站的编号，从而使列车得到控制。

为了找到列车，调度员 Sarah 给了你一个装置。你可以用它选择任意的数 l$$$l$$$ 和 r$$$r$$$(l≤r$$$l \le r$$$)，然后查询列车是否位于编号在 l$$$l$$$ 到 r$$$r$$$ 之间(包含端点)的车站。不幸的是，该装置的充电需要一定时间(并且每次使用后你都会立即再次使用它)，因此在两次使用装置之间，列车可以移动到距离当前位置至多 k$$$k$$$ 个车站的位置。形式化地说，如果使用装置时列车位于车站 x$$$x$$$，那么在下一次使用装置时，列车可以出现在满足 max(1,x−k)≤y≤min(n,x+k)$$$\max(1, x - k) \leq y \leq \min(n, x + k)$$$ 的任意车站 y$$$y$$$。
注意，AI 不知道你正在试图抓住列车，因此它会按照预先制定的计划进行所有移动。
检查装置后，你发现它非常老旧，最多只能使用 4500$$$4500$$$ 次，超过次数后装置就会损坏，你的任务也将被判定为失败。
你能否通过不超过 4500$$$4500$$$ 次使用装置，找到列车所在的车站？

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$(1≤n≤1018$$$1 \leq n \leq 10^{18}$$$，0≤k≤10$$$0 \leq k \leq 10$$$)——分别表示车站数量，以及两次使用装置之间列车最多可以移动的车站数。

你最多可以使用装置 4500$$$4500$$$ 次。要使用装置，你需要输出两个用空格分隔的整数 l$$$l$$$ 和 r$$$r$$$(1≤l≤r≤n$$$1 \leq l \leq r \leq n$$$)。随后，如果列车位于车站 l$$$l$$$ 到 r$$$r$$$ 之间(包含两端)，你会收到字符串 "Yes"，否则会收到字符串 "No"。如果 l=r$$$l = r$$$ 且你收到 "Yes"，则表示你已成功找到列车，你的程序必须立即终止。
如果收到 "Bad" 而不是 "Yes" 或 "No"，则表示你进行了无效查询或查询次数过多。收到 "Bad" 后立即退出，否则由于你的解决方案会继续从已关闭的输入流中读取，你可能会得到任意判定结果。
输出查询后，别忘了输出换行符并刷新输出缓冲区，否则你会收到 Idleness limit exceeded。要做到这一点，请使用：
在 C++ 中使用 fflush(stdout) 或 cout.flush()；
其他语言请参阅相关文档。
为了进行 Hack，你应按照以下格式提交测试用例。
第一行应包含三个整数 n$$$n$$$、k$$$k$$$ 和 p$$$p$$$(1≤n≤1018$$$1 \le n \le 10^{18}$$$，0≤k≤10$$$0 \le k \le 10$$$，1≤p≤n$$$1 \le p \le n$$$)，分别表示车站数量、列车两次使用装置之间最多可以移动的车站数，以及列车的初始位置。
接下来的 4500$$$4500$$$ 行中，每行应包含一个整数 x$$$x$$$(1≤x≤n$$$1 \le x \le n$$$)，表示每次查询后列车的位置。任意两个连续的位置(包括初始位置)之差都不应超过 k$$$k$$$。
